_source: design_system/v1_0_threejs_soulslike/DECISIONS.md D6 (Names / the Open Page / the Hearth / attributes / Burden) + PRD R5/R7 + TUNING_V0.md. Keys prefixed with _ are provenance notes and are stripped before the data<->code parity comparison (see data.parity.test.ts).

attributes._source: D6 attribute set verbatim: Pulse (HP) / Breath (stamina) / Hands (weapon force + craft) / Steady (poise + guard stability) / Spirit (Tincture potency + Wither resist) / Sight (discovery + Attend range). breath.base 100 and steady.base 20 are TUNING_V0 verbatim ('Breath (stamina, 100 base)', 'Kalev base 20'); sight.base 1500cm is TUNING_V0 Attend range 15m verbatim. pulse/hands/spirit bases and every segment curve are AUTHORED (TUNING_V0 gives no level curves). Units are integers so every derived value stays exact.

level._source: AUTHORED. cost(spent) = costBase + costLinear*spent + costQuad*spent^2, where spent is the total attribute points already written into the notebook. Integer by construction.

names._source: AUTHORED award table. Sources are the three accrual events named in the slice contract (kill / witness / notebook) over the ENCOUNTERS.md Ironwood cast.

burden._source: Band thresholds are TUNING_V0 § Movement & defense verbatim: Light (<30%) / Medium (30-70%) / Heavy (>70%). Capacity curve AUTHORED and driven by Steady (D6: Steady is postural stability; 'bearing it is the work').

openPage._source: D6 (the Open Page: one recovery; second death loses them) + GATES F11 ('Open Page within 0.5m of death site') - the page is recorded at the exact death position, so the drop offset is 0m. recoveryRadiusM AUTHORED (pickup reach).

respawn._source: PRD R7 + D7: Hearth rest respawns standard enemies; bosses never respawn (the Warden is excluded via the boss-arena state machine).
